Introducing this semi-detached family home in a cul-de-sac location. The property features a living room, a recently installed kitchen, and a sunroom, offering a perfect space to relax and unwind. With three bedrooms and a first-floor bathroom, this home provides ample space for a growing family.

Outside, a generous rear garden and ample off-street parking to the front add to the appeal. While some updating is required, this property has the potential to be transformed into a lovely family home.

Ideal for first-time buyers or as a buy-to-let investment opportunity, this property offers versatile living spaces and great potential. Don't miss out on the chance to make this property your own. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and discover the possibilities this home has to offer.

Directions From the city centre head west on the A595. On reaching the traffic lights at Morton turn right onto Orton Road. Take the third right onto Dobinson Avenue.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
